# Sources of the tester fixtures

Every file in this folder is generated by `make_tester_fixtures.py` (Pillow, MIT-CMU, used only as
a tool). No photograph or third-party picture is included; the pixels are flat colours and zeros.

`fuzz_webp_exif_claims_4gib.webp` (108 bytes) is a reproducer saved by the `decode_webp` cargo-fuzz
target in `../../fuzz/` (mutated from `../images/webp_*.webp`); its EXIF chunk claims 0xFF00001A bytes.
